meta.name: content-model-handoff
meta.description: Use when splitting content work between a raw drafting model/window, an editor-in-chief, and the user's final taste review. It keeps prompts loose enough for judgment while preserving facts, account boundaries, and publish gates.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分草稿、编辑与终审的内容协作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要多人协作完成内容创作并控制发布质量
copy.tagline_en: Split content work between drafting, editing, and final review
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate content creation with multiple roles and quality gates

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照“原始草稿 → 主编审核 → 用户品味/事实审查 → 平台包装/发布”的流程来管理内容生产，确保草稿的创造力和发布的判断力分离。
howto.when: 当你需要将内容创作拆分为原始草稿和最终发布两个阶段，并且有专门的模型或窗口负责初稿，而你自己或主编负责策略和事实把关时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇小红书笔记的原始草稿，先给几个方向。
say.note: Claude 会先提供多个方向，再给出一个原始草稿。

say.text: 这是初稿，请作为主编审核一下，列出保留、删除和需要我确认的部分。
say.note: Claude 会按照主编角色进行审核。

say.text: 请为这个抖音口播稿生成原始草稿，并保存到 raw 文件夹。
say.note: Claude 会生成草稿并建议保存路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude manages content production through a workflow: raw draft → editor-in-chief review → user taste/truth review → platform packaging/publish, separating draft creativity from publishing judgment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to split content work into raw drafting and final publishing, with a dedicated model/window for drafts and yourself or an editor-in-chief handling strategy and fact-checking.

say_en.text: Write a raw draft for a Xiaohongshu post, first give a few directions.
say_en.note: Claude will provide multiple directions first, then a raw draft.

say_en.text: Here is the first draft. Review it as editor-in-chief, list keep/cut/confirm items.
Generate a raw draft for this Douyin script and save it to the raw folder.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the draft and suggest a save path.
